=== Sequels ===
==== ''The Legend of Korra'' (2012–2014) ====
{{Main|The Legend of Korra{{!}}''The Legend of Korra''}}

''[[The Legend of Korra]]'', a sequel series to ''Avatar: The Last Airbender'', premiered on Nickelodeon on April 14, 2012.<ref name="press">{{Cite web |date=March 15, 2012 |title=Nick Press The Legend of Korra press release |url=http://biz.viacom.com/sites/nickelodeonpress/NICKELODEON/Pages/showpdf.aspx?FileName=TheLegendofKorra%20FINAL.pdf&ItemID=625&ListName=Press%20Releases |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20130928120459/http://biz.viacom.com/sites/nickelodeonpress/NICKELODEON/Pages/showpdf.aspx?FileName=TheLegendofKorra%20FINAL.pdf&ItemID=625&ListName=Press%20Releases |archive-date=September 28, 2013 |website=Nick Press |format=PDF}}</ref> It was written and produced by ''Avatar: The Last Airbender'' creators Michael Dante DiMartino and Bryan Konietzko, the creators and producers of the original series.<ref name="ToonZone">{{cite web |last1=Liu |first1=Ed |date=April 19, 2010 |title=Nickelodeon Studios Staffing Up for New "Avatar the Last Airbender" Project |url=http://www.toonzone.net/2010/04/nickelodeon-studios-staffing-for-new-avatar-the-last-airbender-project |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://archive.today/20140419223233/http://www.toonzone.net/2010/04/nickelodeon-studios-staffing-for-new-avatar-the-last-airbender-project |archive-date=April 19, 2014 |publisher=Toon Zone LLC}}</ref> The show was initially titled ''Avatar: Legend of Korra'', then ''The Last Airbender: Legend of Korra''; its events occur seventy years after the end of ''Avatar: The Last Airbender''.<ref>{{cite web |title=Animation News Discussion Cartoon Community&nbsp;– toonzone news |url=http://www.toonzone.net/news/articles/34609/sdcc2010--batman-under-the-red-hood-roundtables-pt-2-timm-greenwood-amp-romano |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20100805125255/http://www.toonzone.net/news/articles/34609/sdcc2010--batman-under-the-red-hood-roundtables-pt-2-timm-greenwood-amp-romano |archive-date=August 5, 2010 |publisher=Toonzone.net}}</ref> The series' protagonist is [[Korra (The Legend of Korra)|Korra]], a 17-year-old girl from the Southern Water Tribe who is the incarnation of the Avatar after Aang's death.<ref name="press" /> The series ran for 4 seasons, ending after 52 episodes on December 19, 2014.<ref>{{cite web |last=Nicholson |first=Max |date=December 23, 2014 |title=THE LEGEND OF KORRA: BOOK FOUR REVIEW |url=http://www.ign.com/articles/2014/12/24/the-legend-of-korra-book-four-balance-review |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180812093213/http://www.ign.com/articles/2014/12/24/the-legend-of-korra-book-four-balance-review |archive-date=August 12, 2018 |access-date=August 12, 2018 |publisher=[[IGN]]}}</ref>

==== ''Avatar: Seven Havens'' (2026–present) ====
{{Main|Avatar: Seven Havens{{!}}''Avatar: Seven Havens''}}
On February 20, 2025, 20 years after the original show debuted, it was announced that a new sequel titled ''Avatar: Seven Havens'' was green-lit. The series will consist of 26 episodes, spread across two seasons, and will be produced by DiMartino and Konietzko.<ref>{{cite magazine|url=https://variety.com/2025/tv/news/avatar-last-airbender-seven-havens-animated-series-nickelodeon-1236313495/|title=Avatar: Seven Havens Officially Announced, Set After the Events of The Legend of Korra|first=Joe|last=Otterson|magazine=[[Variety (magazine)|Variety]]|date=February 20, 2025|access-date=February 20, 2025|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250220171550/https://variety.com/2025/tv/news/avatar-last-airbender-seven-havens-animated-series-nickelodeon-1236313495/|archive-date=February 20, 2025|url-status=live}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.polygon.com/tv/526440/new-avatar-atla-series-seven-havens-news-announcement|title=Nickelodeon is finally giving us a new Avatar: The Last Airbender show|first=Zosha|last=Millman|website=[[Polygon (website)|Polygon]]|date=February 20, 2025|access-date=February 21, 2025|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250220195213/https://www.polygon.com/tv/526440/new-avatar-atla-series-seven-havens-news-announcement|archive-date=February 20, 2025|url-status=live}}</ref> ''Avatar: Seven Havens'' premiered on October 9, 2026, on [[Paramount+]].<ref name="Otterson-2026">{{Cite web |last=Otterson|first=Joe|date=July 23, 2026|title=‘Avatar: Seven Havens’ Sets 2026 Release Date at Paramount+, Drops Apocalyptic First Teaser|url=https://variety.com/2026/tv/news/avatar-seven-havens-release-date-teaser-1236819641/|access-date=July 23, 2026|website=[[Variety (magazine)|Variety]]|language=en-US|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20260724000915/https://variety.com/2026/tv/news/avatar-seven-havens-release-date-teaser-1236819641/|archive-date=July 24, 2026|url-status=live}}</ref>

==== ''Avatar Aang: The Last Airbender'' film (2026) ====
{{Main|Avatar Aang: The Last Airbender{{!}}''Avatar Aang: The Last Airbender''}}

In February 2021, along with the announcement of the formation of [[Avatar Studios (production company)|Avatar Studios]], it was reported that the studio's first project would be an animated theatrical film that would begin production later in 2021.<ref name=":02">{{Cite web |last=White |first=Peter |date=2021-02-24 |title='Avatar: The Last Airbender' Franchise To Expand With Launch Of Nickelodeon's Avatar Studios, Animated Theatrical Film In The Works |url=https://deadline.com/2021/02/avatar-the-last-airbender-franchise-expansion-launch-nickelodeons-avatar-studios-animated-theatrical-film-1234699594/ |access-date=2021-02-24 |website=Deadline |language=en-US}}</ref> In June 2022, it was announced that [[Lauren Montgomery]], a former storyboard artist on ''Avatar: The Last Airbender'' and a supervising producer for ''Korra'', would serve as director.<ref name="AvatarFilms">{{Cite web |last1=Galuppo |first1=Mia |date=June 15, 2022 |title=Three 'Avatar: The Last Airbender' Films Set at Paramount, Nickelodeon |url=https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/movies/movie-news/paramount-nickelodeon-avatar-films-1235165753/ |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220704233346/https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/movies/movie-news/paramount-nickelodeon-avatar-films-1235165753/ |archive-date=July 4, 2022 |access-date=June 15, 2022 |website=[[The Hollywood Reporter]] |language=en-US}}</ref> In April 2024, Paramount revealed the film's tentative title, ''Aang: The Last Airbender'', along with the casting of [[Eric Nam]] as Aang, [[Dionne Quan]] as Toph, [[Jessica Matten]] as Katara, Román Zaragoza as Sokka, and [[Dave Bautista]] as an antagonist.<ref>{{cite magazine |last=Wang |first=Jessica |date=April 11, 2024 |title=Aang: The Last Airbender, the first animated movie in Avatar trilogy, will follow Aang as an adult |url=https://ew.com/aang-the-last-airbender-first-movie-avatar-trilogy-eric-nam-dave-bautista-8630272 |access-date=April 11, 2024 |magazine=[[Entertainment Weekly]]}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |last=Graves |first=Sabina |date=2024-04-11 |title=Aang: The Last Airbender Movie Has Found Its Cast, Including Dave Bautista |url=https://gizmodo.com/last-airbender-animated-trilogy-aang-first-movie-2025-1851404099 |access-date=2024-04-11 |website=[[Gizmodo]]}}</ref>

==== ''Avatar Kuruk: Wave of Chaos'' ====
On October 9, 2026, alongside the announcement of ''Seven Havens'' being renewed for additional seasons, a new animated series was given a production order for Paramount+. Described as an action comedy, it is a prequel set before Aang's story about a 14 year old Kuruk during a time of peace.<ref name="Kuruk">{{Cite web |last=White |first=Abbey |date=2026-10-09 |title=‘Avatar: Seven Havens’ Renewed for Two More Seasons, ‘Avatar Kuruk: Wave of Chaos’ Series Announced at NYCC |url=https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/tv/tv-news/avatar-seven-havens-renewed-kuruk-wave-of-chaos-series-1236726315/ |access-date=2026-10-09 |website=The Hollywood Reporter |language=en-US}}</ref>

== Other media ==

=== Books ===
Several books based on the show have been published. [[Dark Horse Comics]] published an art book titled ''Avatar: The Last Airbender&nbsp;– The Art of the Animated Series'' on June 2, 2010, with 184 pages of original art from the series.<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.darkhorse.com/Books/16-782/Avatar-The-Last-Airbender---The-Art-of-the-Animated-Series |title=Avatar: The Last Airbender&nbsp;— The Art of the Animated Series :: Profile :: Dark Horse Comics |publisher=[[Dark Horse Comics]] |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20121106034838/http://www.darkhorse.com/Books/16-782/Avatar-The-Last-Airbender---The-Art-of-the-Animated-Series |archive-date=November 6, 2012}}</ref> A second edition of the book was released on November 25, 2020, featuring a new cover and eight new pages.<ref>{{cite web |title=Avatar: The Last Airbender The Art of the Animated Series Deluxe (Second Edition) |url=https://www.penguinrandomhouse.com/books/658429/avatar-the-last-airbender--the-art-of-the-animated-series-deluxe-second-edition-by-written-by-michael-dante-dimartino-and-bryan-konietzko/ |access-date=2024-04-17 |website=PenguinRandomHouse.com |language=en-US}}</ref>

''Chronicles of the Avatar'' is a series of novels that tell the stories of the Avatars before [[Aang]].<ref>{{Cite book |last1=Yee |first1=F. C. |title=AVATAR, THE LAST AIRBENDER: THE RISE OF KYOSHI (CHRONICLES OF THE AVATAR BOOK 1) |last2=Dimartino |first2=Michael Dante |publisher=Amulet Books |year=2019 |isbn=9781419735042 |language=en}}</ref> The series began with the [[young adult novel]] duology focusing on [[Avatar Kyoshi]], which was written by F. C. Yee. The first book, ''[[Avatar: The Last Airbender – The Rise of Kyoshi]]'', was published in July 2019 by Abrams Children's Books.<ref>{{cite magazine |last=Canfield |first=David |date=August 29, 2018 |title=Avatar: The Last Airbender universe to expand with new novels |url=https://ew.com/books/2018/08/29/avatar-the-last-airbender-novels/ |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20181003071925/https://ew.com/books/2018/08/29/avatar-the-last-airbender-novels/ |archive-date=October 3, 2018 |access-date=September 6, 2018 |magazine=[[Entertainment Weekly]]}}</ref> The second part in the series, titled ''[[Avatar: The Last Airbender – The Shadow of Kyoshi|The Shadow of Kyoshi]]'', was released on July 21, 2020.<ref>{{Cite book |last1=Yee |first1=F. C. |title=Avatar, The Last Airbender: The Shadow of Kyoshi (The Kyoshi Novels Book 2) Hardcover – July 21, 2020 |last2=Dimartino |first2=Michael Dante |publisher=Amulet Books |year=2020 |isbn=978-1419735059 |language=en}}</ref> The duology was followed by the third novel ''The Dawn of Yangchen'', also written by Yee and released on July 19, 2022.<ref>{{Cite book |last=Yee |first=F. C. |title=AVATAR, THE LAST AIRBENDER: THE DAWN OF YANGCHEN (CHRONICLES OF THE AVATAR BOOK 3) |publisher=Amulet Books |year=2022 |isbn=9781419756771 |language=en}}</ref> Yee's fourth novel in the series, ''The Legacy of Yangchen'', was released on July 18, 2023.<ref>{{Cite book |last=Yee |first=F. C. |title=AVATAR, THE LAST AIRBENDER: THE LEGACY OF YANGCHEN (CHRONICLES OF THE AVATAR BOOK 4) |publisher=Amulet Books |year=2023 |isbn=9781419756795 |language=en}}</ref> The fifth book of the series, titled ''The Reckoning of Roku'', focuses on Avatar Roku is written by Randy Ribay and released on July 23, 2024.<ref>{{Cite book |last=Ribay |first=Randy |title=AVATAR, THE LAST AIRBENDER: THE RECKONING OF ROKU (CHRONICLES OF THE AVATAR BOOK 5) |publisher=Amulet Books |year=2024 |isbn=9781419776038 |language=en}}</ref> The sixth novel, ''The Awakening of Roku'', was also written by Ribay and released on December 30, 2025.<ref>{{Cite book |last=Ribay |first=Randy |title=Avatar: The Last Airbender: The Awakening of Roku (Chronicles of the Avatar Book 6) |date=December 30, 2025 |publisher=Harry N. Abrams |year=2025 |isbn=1419780662}}</ref>

=== Comics ===
{{Main|Avatar: The Last Airbender (comics){{!}}''Avatar: The Last Airbender'' (comics)}}

Several comic-book short stories were published in ''[[Nickelodeon Magazine]]'', and Dark Horse published ''Avatar: The Last Airbender&nbsp;– The Lost Adventures''—a collection of these and new comics—on June 15, 2011.<ref name="darkhorse1">{{cite web |url=http://www.darkhorse.com/Books/18-849/Avatar-The-Last-Airbender-The-Lost-Adventures |title=Avatar: The Last Airbender&nbsp;— The Lost Adventures :: Profile :: Dark Horse Comics |publisher=[[Dark Horse Comics]] |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120923060253/http://www.darkhorse.com/Books/18-849/Avatar-The-Last-Airbender-The-Lost-Adventures |archive-date=September 23, 2012}}</ref>

Dark Horse published a graphic-novel series by [[Gene Yang]] that continues Aang's story after the Hundred Years' War. ''[[Avatar: The Last Airbender&nbsp;– The Promise]]'', published in three volumes in 2012, explores the fate of the Fire Nation colonies that become ''[[The Legend of Korra]]''{{'}}s United Republic. This series was translated into Hebrew in 2016–2017.<ref>{{Cite web |title=The National Library of Israel |url=https://www.nli.org.il/en/books/NNL_ALEPH003943671/NLI |access-date=June 29, 2020 |archive-date=May 14, 2021 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210514191352/https://www.nli.org.il/en/books/NNL_ALEPH003943671/NLI |url-status=live}}</ref> A second set of three comic books, ''[[Avatar: The Last Airbender&nbsp;– The Search]]'', focuses on Zuko and Azula, and the fate of their mother Ursa.<ref name="CBR 25 June 2012">{{cite news |last=Sunu |first=Steve |title=EXCLUSIVE: Yang Continues "Avatar: The Last Airbender" in "The Search" |url=http://www.comicbookresources.com/?page=article&id=39354 |newspaper=[[Comic Book Resources]] |date=June 25, 2012 |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120627224446/http://www.comicbookresources.com/?page=article&id=39354 |archive-date=June 27, 2012}}</ref> The second set was translated into Hebrew in 2018–2019.<ref>{{Cite web |title=The National Library of Israel |url=https://www.nli.org.il/en/books/NNL_ALEPH004426931/NLI |access-date=June 29, 2020 |archive-date=May 14, 2021 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210514191422/https://www.nli.org.il/en/books/NNL_ALEPH004426931/NLI |url-status=live}}</ref> The third set, ''[[Avatar: The Last Airbender&nbsp;– The Rift]]'', shifts the focus to Aang, the creation of Republic City, and Toph's relationship with her family.<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://www.comicbookresources.com/?page=article&id=46878 |title=SDCC EXCLUSIVE: Yang Takes "Avatar: The Last Airbender" To "The Rift" |date=July 24, 2013 |access-date=July 29, 2014 |website=Comic Book Resources |last=Phegley |first=Kiel |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20141213085812/http://www.comicbookresources.com/?page=article&id=46878 |archive-date=December 13, 2014 |df=mdy-all}}</ref> ''The Rift'' was followed by ''[[Avatar: The Last Airbender – Smoke and Shadow]]'' about a resistance force in the Fire Nation against Firelord Zuko, who at the end of the original series assumed the throne.<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.darkhorse.com/Books/25-394/Avatar-The-Last-Airbender--Smoke-and-Shadow-Part-Three-TPB |title=Avatar: The Last Airbender — Smoke and Shadow (Part Three) |publisher=Dark Horse Comics |access-date=January 26, 2017 |archive-date=February 19, 2017 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170219050136/http://www.darkhorse.com/Books/25-394/Avatar-The-Last-Airbender--Smoke-and-Shadow-Part-Three-TPB |url-status=live}}</ref> The fifth graphic novel was ''[[Avatar: The Last Airbender – North and South]]'', which follows the events of ''Smoke and Shadow'' and is about Katara and Sokka returning to the Water Tribe to see various changes to their homeland.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.cbr.com/exclusive-new-avatar-the-last-airbender-graphic-novel-series-debuts-in-2016/ |title=New "Avatar: The Last Airbender" Graphic Novel Series Debuts in 2016 |last1=Gerding |first1=Stephen |website=Comic Book Resources |date=February 18, 2016 |access-date=February 19, 2016 |archive-date=February 19, 2016 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160219091457/http://www.comicbookresources.com/article/exclusive-new-avatar-the-last-airbender-graphic-novel-series-debuts-in-2016 |url-status=live}}</ref> The next graphic novel is titled ''Imbalance'' and was released in October 2018. The series explores the emerging conflict between the benders and non-benders that becomes the center for the conflict in the first season of the sequel, ''The Legend of Korra''. Unlike the previous five books it was written by Faith Erin Hicks.<ref>{{Cite news |url=http://ew.com/books/2018/02/26/dark-horse-announces-new-avatar-the-last-airbender-comics/ |title=Dark Horse announces new 'Avatar: The Last Airbender' comics |work=EW.com |access-date=June 2, 2018 |language=en |archive-date=May 31, 2018 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180531091413/http://ew.com/books/2018/02/26/dark-horse-announces-new-avatar-the-last-airbender-comics/ |url-status=live}}</ref>

In 2020, Dark Horse began publishing standalone comics, the first of which was ''Katara and the Pirate's Silver'' which was written by Faith Erin Hicks and Tim Hedrick and follows [[Katara (Avatar: The Last Airbender)|Katara]] aligning herself with a group of pirates after she gets separated from the rest of Team Avatar.<ref>{{cite web |date=2020-10-20 |title=REVIEW: Avatar: Katara and the Pirate's Silver Puts a Much-Needed Spotlight on Its Hero |url=https://www.cbr.com/review-avatar-katara-and-the-pirates-silver/ |access-date=2021-06-19 |website=CBR |language=en-US}}</ref> The comic was released on October 13, 2020.<ref>{{cite web |title=Avatar: The Last Airbender--Katara and the Pirate's Silver by Faith Erin Hicks: 9781506717111 |url=https://www.penguinrandomhouse.com/books/653128/avatar-the-last-airbender--katara-and-the-pirates-silver-by-written-by-faith-erin-hicks-illustrated-by-peter-wartman-colored-by-adele-matera/ |access-date=2021-06-19 |website=PenguinRandomHouse.com |language=en-US}}</ref> It was followed by ''Toph Beifong's Metalbending Academy'' on February 17, 2021, which follows [[Toph Beifong|Toph]] in between the events of ''The Rift'' and ''Smoke and Shadow''.<ref>{{cite web |title=Avatar: The Last Airbender-- Toph Beifong's Metalbending Academy |url=https://digital.darkhorse.com/books/33a317fe9f5c46e9a4e8a46ae9d43737/avatar-the-last-airbender-toph-beifongs-metalbending-academy |access-date=2021-06-20 |website=Dark Horse Digital Comics}}</ref><ref>{{cite tweet |last1=Erin Hicks |first1=Faith |user=faitherinhicks |title=This comic is set after the events of The Rift & has lots of punching, feelings & terrible music (really). It's been really fun to write these stand-alone comics & Peter has been killing it on art. I've been working with Tim Hedrick, who is also super great. |number=1287846657975914496 |access-date=2021-06-20 |website=Twitter |language=en}}</ref> This was followed by ''Suki, Alone'', released on June 27, 2021, and follows Suki when she was imprisoned after the events of the episode "[[Appa's Lost Days]]".<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.darkhorse.com/Books/3005-786/Avatar-The-Last-Airbender--Suki-Alone-TPB|title=AVATAR: THE LAST AIRBENDER--SUKI, ALONE TPB|accessdate=2021-04-03|publisher=Dark Horse}}</ref> These three standalone comics were released in a boxed set in November 2021 under the name ''Team Avatar Treasury''.<ref>{{cite web |title=Avatar: The Last Airbender–Team Avatar Treasury Boxed Set (Graphic Novels) |url=https://www.penguinrandomhouse.com/books/710752/avatar-the-last-airbender--team-avatar-treasury-boxed-set-graphic-novels-by-written-by-faith-erin-hicks-illustrated-by-peter-wartman-and-adele-matera/ |access-date=2024-04-17 |website=PenguinRandomHouse.com |language=en-US}}</ref> This was followed by 2023's ''Azula in the Spirit Temple'',<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.darkhorse.com/Books/3009-125/Avatar-The-Last-Airbender--Azula-in-the-Spirit-Temple-TPB|title=AVATAR: THE LAST AIRBENDER--AZULA IN THE SPIRIT TEMPLE TPB|accessdate=2024-04-17|publisher=Dark Horse}}</ref> and 2024's ''The Bounty Hunter and the Tea Brewer'', which focuses on [[Iroh]] and June the Bounty Hunter.<ref>{{Cite web |last1=Rusak |first1=Rotem |date=September 14, 2023 |title=AVATAR: THE LAST AIRBENDER: THE BOUNTY HUNTER AND THE TEA BREWER ANNOUNCES RELEASE DATE AND PLOT DETAILS |url=https://nerdist.com/article/avatar-the-last-airbender-the-bounty-hunter-and-the-tea-brewer-graphic-novel-announces-release-date-plot-details-uncle-iroh-june-adventure/ |access-date=April 17, 2024 |website=The Nerdist |language=en-US}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |title=Avatar: The Last Airbender — The Bounty Hunter and the Tea Brewer |url=https://www.penguinrandomhouse.com/books/739201/avatar-the-last-airbender----the-bounty-hunter-and-the-tea-brewer-by-written-by-faith-erin-hicks-illustrated-by-peter-wartman-colored-by-adele-matera-in-cooperation-with-michael-dante-dimartino-and-bryan-konietzko/ |access-date=2024-04-17 |website=PenguinRandomHouse.com |language=en-US}}</ref>

=== Video games ===
A video-game trilogy based on the series has been released. The ''[[Avatar: The Last Airbender (video game)|Avatar: The Last Airbender]]'' video game was released on October 10, 2006,<ref>{{Cite web |url=https://www.gamespot.com/avatar-the-last-airbender/ |title=Avatar: The Last Airbender |website=[[GameSpot]] |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20071217111256/http://www.nicksplat.com/Whatsup/200510/12000135.html |archive-date=December 17, 2007 |url-status=live}}</ref> and ''[[Avatar: The Last Airbender&nbsp;– The Burning Earth]]'' was released on October 16, 2007.<ref>{{Cite web |url=https://www.gamespot.com/avatar-the-last-airbender-the-burning-earth/ |title=Avatar: The Last Airbender – The Burning Earth |website=[[GameSpot]] |date=November 5, 2007 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20171016210052/https://www.gamespot.com/avatar-the-last-airbender-the-burning-earth/ |archive-date=October 16, 2017 |url-status=live}}</ref> ''[[Avatar: The Last Airbender – Into the Inferno]]'' was released on October 13, 2008.<ref>{{Cite web |url=https://www.gamespot.com/avatar-the-last-airbender-into-the-inferno/ |title=Avatar: The Last Airbender – Into the Inferno |website=[[GameSpot]] |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20070108101432/http://www.musogato.com/avatar/calligraphy.html |archive-date=January 8, 2007 |url-status=live}}</ref> ''Avatar: Legends of the Arena'', a [[massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] (MMORPG) for [[Microsoft Windows]], was released on September 15, 2008, by [[Nickelodeon]]. Players can create their own character and interact with other players around the world.<ref>{{cite news |title=Nickelodeon Launching Avatar MMORPG Worldwide In September |url=http://www.worldsinmotion.biz/2008/07/nickelodeon_launching_avatar_m.php |work=Worlds in Motion |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20080908023425/http://www.worldsinmotion.biz/2008/07/nickelodeon_launching_avatar_m.php |archive-date=September 8, 2008 |url-status=live}}</ref> ''Avatar: The Last Airbender'' was [[THQ]]'s bestselling Nickelodeon game in 2006 and was one of [[Sony]] CEA's Greatest Hits.<ref>{{cite web |author=Jose Liz |title=THQ's Avatar Now Available for $20 |url=http://www.pgnx.net/news.php?page=full&id=14399 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20070827215413/http://www.pgnx.net/news.php?page=full&id=14399 |url-status=dead |archive-date=August 27, 2007 |date=July 19, 2007}}</ref> Aang and Zuko appear as skins for Merlin and Susano, respectively, in ''[[Smite (video game)|Smite]]''.<ref>{{Cite magazine |last=Tack |first=Daniel |title=Avatar: The Last Airbender Comes To Smite Today |url=https://www.gameinformer.com/2020/07/14/avatar-the-last-airbender-comes-to-smite-today |access-date=October 17, 2020 |magazine=Game Informer |language=en |archive-date=October 18, 2020 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20201018005557/https://www.gameinformer.com/2020/07/14/avatar-the-last-airbender-comes-to-smite-today |url-status=live}}</ref> A turn-based role-playing game by Navigation Games, titled ''Avatar Generations'', was released in early 2023 for [[iOS]] and [[Android (operating system)|Android]].<ref>{{Cite web |url=https://www.gematsu.com/2023/01/avatar-generations-launches-in-early-2023-gameplay-trailer |title=Avatar Generations launches in early 2023, gameplay trailer |last=Romano |first=Sal |website=Gematsu |date=January 10, 2023 |access-date=January 10, 2023 |archive-date=January 10, 2023 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230110140609/https://www.gematsu.com/2023/01/avatar-generations-launches-in-early-2023-gameplay-trailer |url-status=live}}</ref> In September 2023, GameMill Entertainment released ''Avatar: The Last Airbender - Quest for Balance'', which loosely adapts the events of the entire show.<ref>{{Cite web |url=https://www.ign.com/articles/avatar-the-last-airbender-quest-for-balance-review |title=Avatar: The Last Airbender - Quest for Balance Review |first=Tom |last=Marks |date=September 28, 2023 |website=IGN |access-date=October 27, 2023 |archive-date=October 27, 2023 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20231027160720/https://www.ign.com/articles/avatar-the-last-airbender-quest-for-balance-review |url-status=live}}</ref> ''Avatar: The Last Airbender'' characters and locations are also featured in several Nickelodeon crossover games, including ''[[Nickelodeon Kart Racers 2: Grand Prix]]'' and ''[[Nickelodeon Kart Racers 3: Slime Speedway|3: Slime Speedway]]'', and the ''[[Nickelodeon All-Star Brawl]]'' series.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Acebedo |first=Bayani Miguel |date=June 11, 2020 |title=Nickelodeon Kart Racers 2 Trailer Brings Together Nicktoons Like Spongebob, Zim, Aang, and Korra |url=https://epicstream.com/news/BayaniMiguelAcebedo/Nickelodeon-Kart-Racers-2-Trailer-Brings-Together-Nicktoons-Like-Spongebob-Zim-Aang-and-Korra |url-status=live |access-date=May 1, 2021 |website=Epicstream |language=en-US |archive-date=May 1, 2021 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210501091027/https://epicstream.com/news/BayaniMiguelAcebedo/Nickelodeon-Kart-Racers-2-Trailer-Brings-Together-Nicktoons-Like-Spongebob-Zim-Aang-and-Korra}}</ref> ''Avatar: The Last Airbender'' themed content is set to be released as downloadable content in ''[[Sonic Racing: CrossWorlds]]''.<ref>{{cite web | last=Doolan | first=Liam | title=Sonic Racing: CrossWorlds Officially Reveals Nickelodeon Collaboration | website=Nintendo Life | date=June 22, 2025 | url=https://www.nintendolife.com/news/2025/06/sonic-racing-crossworlds-officially-reveals-nickelodeon-collaboration | access-date=June 22, 2025}}</ref> A motion-based game starring Toph called ''Avatar: The Last Airbender Earth Rumble'' launched on [[Nex Playground]] on April 28, 2026.<ref>{{cite press-release|url=https://secure.businesswire.com/news/home/20260428506776/en/Avatar-The-Last-Airbender-Earth-Rumble-Available-Today-on-Nex-Playground|title=Avatar: The Last Airbender Earth Rumble Available Today on Nex Playground|location=[[San Francisco]]|publisher=[[Nex Playground]]|agency=[[Businesswire]]|date=April 28, 2026|access-date=June 19, 2026}}</ref>

=== Concert ===
{{Main|Avatar: The Last Airbender in Concert}}

In October 2023, Nickelodeon and GEA Live announced ''Avatar: The Last Airbender in Concert'', an ongoing concert tour featuring Zuckerman's score for the series.<ref name=":16">{{Cite web |last=Dar |first=Taimur |date=October 17, 2023 |title=Experience the music of AVATAR: THE LAST AIRBENDER in concert |url=https://www.comicsbeat.com/avatar-the-last-airbender-in-concert-announced/ |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240509184042/https://www.comicsbeat.com/avatar-the-last-airbender-in-concert-announced/ |archive-date=May 9, 2024 |access-date=May 25, 2024 |website=The Beat |language=en-US}}</ref> The tour was initially announced for four dates and locations in the UK, US, and France, and premiered in [[London, England]] on January 21, 2024.<ref name=":16" /><ref name=":22">{{Cite web |last=Periccos |first=Jack |date=January 22, 2024 |title=Avatar: The Last Airbender In Concert |url=https://www.music-news.com/review/UK/15757/Live/Avatar-The-Last-Airbender-In-Concert-Royal-Festival-Hall |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240525164344/https://www.music-news.com/review/UK/15757/Live/Avatar-The-Last-Airbender-In-Concert-Royal-Festival-Hall |archive-date=May 25, 2024 |access-date=May 25, 2024 |website=Music-News.com |language=en-US}}</ref> The concert runs for over two hours and the music is performed by an orchestral ensemble, while several moments from the series are displayed on a large screen.<ref name=":16" /> Zuckerman, in assistance with DiMartino, Konietzko, and original editor Jeff Adams expanded the series' score and compositions for the concert.<ref name=":03">{{Cite web |last=Shafer |first=Ellise |date=January 23, 2024 |title='Avatar: The Last Airbender' Concert Series Expands to 100-City World Tour (EXCLUSIVE) |url=https://variety.com/2024/music/global/avatar-the-last-airbender-concert-world-tour-1235881877/ |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240525164344/https://variety.com/2024/music/global/avatar-the-last-airbender-concert-world-tour-1235881877/ |archive-date=May 25, 2024 |access-date=May 25, 2024 |website=[[Variety (magazine)|Variety]] |language=en-US}}</ref> The concert is produced by Nickelodeon, GEA Live, and Senbla.<ref>{{Cite press release |title=Avatar: The Last Airbender in Concert Reveals Global Tour Dates |date=April 16, 2024 |publisher=[[Business Wire]] |url=https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20240416584950/en/Avatar-The-Last-Airbender-in-Concert-Reveals-Global-Tour-Dates |access-date=May 27, 2024 |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240525164350/https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20240416584950/en/Avatar-The-Last-Airbender-in-Concert-Reveals-Global-Tour-Dates |archive-date=May 25, 2024}}</ref>
